configDescriptions.OPENID_CONFIGURATION: OIDC discovery document: issuer and all endpoint URLs for app integration
configDescriptions.JWKS: Public JWK set used to verify access/id token signatures
configDescriptions.API_SWAGGER: Interactive docs for the server-to-server admin REST API
configDescriptions.EMBEDDED_SWAGGER: Interactive docs for the embedded auth API (in-page sign-in flows)
configDescriptions.COMPANY_LOGO_URL: Brand logo URL shown on identity pages
configDescriptions.COMPANY_EMAIL_LOGO_URL: Logo URL used in emails (SVG may not render in some email clients)
configDescriptions.EMAIL_SENDER_NAME: Sender display name for outgoing emails
configDescriptions.TERMS_LINK: Terms of service link shown on the sign-up page
configDescriptions.PRIVACY_POLICY_LINK: Privacy policy link shown on the sign-up page
configDescriptions.ENABLE_LOCALE_SELECTOR: Show the locale selector (forced off with a single locale)
configDescriptions.NAMES_IS_REQUIRED: Make names required on sign-up (requires collecting names)
configDescriptions.ENABLE_PASSWORDLESS_SIGN_IN: Enable passwordless (email code) sign-in; forces password sign-up/sign-in/reset off and requires email MFA disabled
configDescriptions.ENABLE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION: Require email verification on sign-up (requires a mailer)
configDescriptions.REPLACE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_WITH_WELCOME_: Send a welcome email instead of the verification email (requires email verification on)
configDescriptions.ENABLE_PASSWORD_RESET: Enable the forgot-password / reset flow (requires a mailer)
configDescriptions.ENABLE_USER_APP_CONSENT: Show the app consent screen on first sign-in to an app
configDescriptions.ENABLE_APP_BANNER: Support custom banners on app sign-in pages
configDescriptions.BLOCKED_POLICIES: User policies blocked from being triggered by end users (e.g. change_password)
configDescriptions.OTP_MFA_IS_REQUIRED: Force every user to enroll authenticator (TOTP) MFA
configDescriptions.SMS_MFA_IS_REQUIRED: Force every user to enroll SMS MFA (requires an SMS provider)
configDescriptions.EMAIL_MFA_IS_REQUIRED: Force every user to enroll email MFA (requires a mailer)
configDescriptions.ENFORCE_ONE_MFA_ENROLLMENT: When no MFA type is strictly required, force users to enroll at least one type from this list; empty means not enforced
configDescriptions.ALLOW_EMAIL_MFA_AS_BACKUP: Allow email MFA as a backup for other MFA types
configDescriptions.ENABLE_RECOVERY_CODE: Enable recovery codes (regain access when all MFA is lost)
configDescriptions.ENABLE_MFA_REMEMBER_DEVICE: Remember the device for 30 days to skip MFA
configDescriptions.ACCOUNT_LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD: Failed sign-in attempts before the account locks, 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.ACCOUNT_LOCKOUT_EXPIRES_IN: Account lock duration (seconds), 0 means indefinite until manual unlock
configDescriptions.UNLOCK_ACCOUNT_VIA_PASSWORD_RESET: Allow unlocking a locked account via password reset
configDescriptions.PASSWORD_RESET_EMAIL_THRESHOLD: Reset emails per email address per day (per IP), 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.PASSWORD_RESET_CODE_THRESHOLD: Failed reset code attempts before temporary lockout, 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.CHANGE_EMAIL_EMAIL_THRESHOLD: Change-email code requests per account per 30 minutes, 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.CHANGE_EMAIL_CODE_THRESHOLD: Failed change-email code attempts before temporary lockout, 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_THRESHOLD: Failed email verification attempts before a 30-minute lockout, 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.EMAIL_MFA_EMAIL_THRESHOLD: Email MFA messages per account per 30 minutes (per IP), 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.SMS_MFA_MESSAGE_THRESHOLD: SMS MFA messages per account per 30 minutes (per IP), 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.MFA_CODE_VERIFY_THRESHOLD: Failed MFA code attempts (email/SMS/OTP/passwordless combined) before a 30-minute lockout, 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.AUTH_CODE_VERIFIER_THRESHOLD: Failed PKCE code_verifier attempts before temporary lockout, 0 means no limit
configDescriptions.GOOGLE_AUTH_CLIENT_ID: Google sign-in client ID; empty hides Google sign-in
configDescriptions.FACEBOOK_AUTH_CLIENT_ID: Facebook sign-in client ID; empty hides it
configDescriptions.GITHUB_AUTH_CLIENT_ID: GitHub sign-in client ID; empty hides it
configDescriptions.GITHUB_AUTH_APP_NAME: App name displayed on the GitHub sign-in button
configDescriptions.DISCORD_AUTH_CLIENT_ID: Discord sign-in client ID; empty hides it
configDescriptions.OIDC_AUTH_PROVIDERS: External OIDC identity providers; per-provider config lives in variable.ts
configDescriptions.ENABLE_EMAIL_LOG: Log outgoing emails; schedule your own cleanup
configDescriptions.ENABLE_SMS_LOG: Log outgoing SMS; schedule your own cleanup
configDescriptions.ENABLE_SIGN_IN_LOG: Log sign-in IP and location; schedule your own cleanup and mind privacy compliance
